API reference

Payment gateway API, version 1.0.0. Generated from the OpenAPI document served at /v1/openapi.json. Authenticate with an Authorization: Bearer header carrying a project API key. List endpoints accept limit (1 to 100) and cursor, and return the next cursor in the X-Next-Cursor header.

GET /events

Pull the event feed, oldest first. Required scope: payments:read.

ParameterInRequired
limitqueryno
cursorqueryno
typequeryno

GET /methods

List enabled payment methods. Required scope: payments:read.

ParameterInRequired
limitqueryno
cursorqueryno

GET /openapi.json

This document. Required scope: undefined.

GET /payments

List payments. Required scope: payments:read.

ParameterInRequired
limitqueryno
cursorqueryno
statusqueryno
referencequeryno
customer_refqueryno
created_fromqueryno
created_toqueryno

POST /payments

Create a payment. Required scope: payments:write.

Request body CreatePayment:

FieldType
amountinteger
cancel_urlstring
currencystring
customer_emailstring
customer_refstring
descriptionstring
discountany
line_itemsarray
metadataobject
methodsarray
referencestring
success_urlstring
taxinteger

GET /payments/{id}

Get a payment. Required scope: payments:read.

ParameterInRequired
idpathyes

POST /payments/{id}/attempts

Start a payment attempt. Required scope: payments:write.

ParameterInRequired
idpathyes

Request body CreateAttempt:

FieldType

optionstring

POST /payments/{id}/cancel

Cancel a payment. Required scope: payments:write.

ParameterInRequired
idpathyes

Request body RefundInput:

FieldType
amountinteger
destinationstring
